summary: SunocoCorp LLC filed an 8-K announcing that its board approved a quarterly cash distribution of $0.9899 per common unit ($3.9596 annualized) for Q1 2026, a 6.25% increase over the prior quarter (including a 5% one-time step-up and 1.25% quarterly increase). The distribution is payable May 20, 2026 to holders of record May 8, 2026. The increase reflects the company's financial stability, accretive acquisitions, and growth projects. This is the sixth consecutive quarterly increase, with a multi-year growth target of at least 5%. No advisor or premium applies. Watch for sustainability of the 5%+ growth trajectory and any future M&A funding needs.
